summary: Frontend-only verification of dark mode + admin gallery bulk upload/reorder features. All 9 verification checks passed (dark toggle on/off, persistence across reload, admin isolated to light, dark restored on return, gallery bulk-upload button + hidden input, 2-file bulk upload creates 2 rows, row draggable=true with grip handle, team add+delete-with-confirm regression).

issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent — minor a11y warning, not user-visible.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout unmount cleanup restores 'dark' by reading localStorage — works correctly here. Consider using the ThemeContext directly to avoid duplicated logic drift.

Bulk upload posts uploads sequentially in a for-loop; for larger batches consider Promise.all with a concurrency limit to speed up UX. Also on partial failure the toast says 'Some uploads failed' but successful items are already created without count in that branch.
onDrop reorder issues N sequential PUTs; acceptable for small lists but a batch reorder endpoint would be more robust.
DialogContent lacks DialogDescription — add for a11y (Radix warning surfaces in console).
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up 2 gallery items (test_bulk_0, test_bulk_1) and 1 team member (TEST_Regression). Gallery ended empty as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode + gallery bulk upload + drag reorder + admin isolation all verified working via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: html.dark class toggles, localStorage.kkn_theme persists, /admin routes force light and restore on exit, [data-testid=gallery-bulk-upload/gallery-bulk-input/gallery-add] present, bulk upload creates one gallery item per file, rows have draggable=true + grip icon when no search filter, team CRUD (add + delete via confirm-delete) works.
